objective: Make the model tester remember its playthrough, follow a focused journey through normal mouse controls, and give evidence-backed player impressions about understanding, navigation, interaction and the world.

requirements.description: Persist player-observed leads, journal, explored ground, attempted actions and goals across decisions and controller continuation; preserve useful UI information without exposing unknown terrain or unplayed outcomes.

Produce durable positive, negative and uncertain playtester comments explaining observations, expectations, interpretation and suggestions, with retained evidence and a readable end-of-run review rather than only command-status reports.

Support a focused settlement-to-discovery-to-dungeon journey, observed-only route guidance, stagnation feedback and measured checkpoints; dogfood the live model and state incomplete coverage honestly.

Preserve isolated saves, real mouse input, dungeon privacy, bounded storage/time, recovery, exact model selection and deterministic gameplay; document the limits of model opinions and any navigation assistance.
